doc: A built gate (design/planner.md, Gates): its mesh, doors as hinged bones (they open by door_time), a portcullis, banners, torches, collision, the passage's width, and guides showing the wall's line.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height, metres (conformance).

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Conformance radius, metres: the farthest it reaches from the origin.

fields.name: fire_points
fields.doc: Where fires burn, metres: hearths, forges, torches, braziers (lit), and points over its roof and walls that burn when it does.

fields.name: fire_configs
fields.doc: Each fire point's fire config (fire_v1_config's id).

fields.name: fire_lit
fields.doc: Each fire point: 1 always lit (a hearth, a torch), 0 only while the building burns, 2 its smoke only (a chimney or a smoke hole: the hearth's smoke without its flames).

fields.name: length
fields.doc: Its extent along the line (local x), metres.

fields.name: half_width
fields.doc: How far it reaches either side of the line (local z), metres.

fields.name: passage
fields.doc: The clear width a walker or cart passes through, metres.

fields.name: passage_height
fields.doc: The clear height of the passage, metres.

fields.name: guide_lines
fields.doc: For the viewer only: line segments as pairs of points (the line the wall runs on, where the next pieces would join, the ground it steps to).

fields.name: guide_colors
fields.doc: Each guide segment's colour, packed RGBA.

fields.name: bones
fields.doc: The moving parts, animated by house_animate_v1.

fields.name: positions
fields.doc: Vertex positions, rest pose, metres.

fields.name: normals
fields.doc: Vertex normals.

fields.name: indices
fields.doc: Triangle list.

fields.name: bone_a
fields.doc: First bone per vertex.

fields.name: bone_b
fields.doc: Second bone per vertex.

fields.name: bone_w
fields.doc: Weight of bone_b per vertex (0 = all bone_a).

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: Vertex colour, packed RGBA (red in the lowest byte).

fields.name: collision
fields.doc: What collides: piers and towers solid, a door leaf solid; the passage a sensor named gateway.
